results.content: In the second quarter of 2026, US consumers faced uneven hiring, rising inflation, and ongoing geopolitical tensions. Against that backdrop, a smaller share of consumers reported feeling more optimistic about the economy, while a greater share said they felt pessimistic. Consumers also reported intentions to pull back spending across most discretionary categories.
